start.description: I rent a single-family house in Gainesville. The air conditioning has been broken since September 1, 2026. On September 10, 2026 I hand-delivered a written notice to the landlord describing the broken air conditioning and saying I will not pay rent until it is fixed. The landlord has not fixed it or replied. The notice says, "The air conditioning has been broken since September 1, 2026. I will not pay rent until it is fixed." It does not say anything about ending my lease. As far as I know nothing anyone did caused it. Nobody has taken me to court.

chat: I would like a letter asking the landlord to repair the air conditioning. Give them 5 days to reply. I will send it by certified mail, return receipt requested. Use the preserve posture, with no quotes.
